paragraphs: A Mercedes-Benz M264 engine rebuild starts from £3,600, regardless of which of the six models it's fitted to - the price tier is set by the engine, not the badge on the boot. A full replacement engine and fitting service is also available.
Exact pricing depends on the condition of your existing engine and the parts required - submit your registration for a fixed-price quote within 30 minutes.

cards.title: Rebuilding Your
cards.body: Most engine suppliers sell you a used engine of unknown history and hope it matches. We rebuild the engine your Mercedes already has instead - strip it down, pressure-test it, and replace every worn or damaged component with updated OEM parts. You get a near-new engine with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty, without the compatibility risk of an unknown used unit. This is the option most M264 owners choose.

cards.title: Replacement
cards.body: If your existing engine is beyond economical repair, we also offer full engine replacement and fitting - sourced and fitted by our team, with the same 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

cards.title: Used
cards.body: In some cases, a matched low-mileage used engine is the right call - particularly if you need your car back on the road quickly and your existing engine's damage is extensive. We can source and fit these too, though most owners who ask about used engines end up choosing a rebuild once they understand the compatibility risk a used unit carries.

options.body: "Reconditioned" is the term many owners search for when they mean the same thing as a rebuild - a full strip-down, inspection, and replacement of worn parts rather than a straight swap. If that's what you're after, our rebuild service is exactly that.
"Refurbished" often describes the same process from a different angle - restoring your existing engine to full working condition rather than replacing it outright. Our rebuild covers this.

Some owners specifically search for a "remanufactured" engine, expecting a unit rebuilt to original specification with updated components. That's consistent with what our rebuild service delivers, regardless of which of the six M264-equipped models you drive.

faqLeft.q: What is the Mercedes-Benz M264 engine?
faqLeft.a: The M264 is Mercedes-Benz's 1.5L or 2.0L turbocharged inline-four petrol engine with 48V mild-hybrid assistance, produced from 2018 to 2023 and fitted to the C-Class W205.

faqLeft.q: Which Mercedes-Benz models use the M264?
faqLeft.a: The M264 was fitted to the C-Class (C 200 and C 300) in the W205 generation from 2018 to 2023.

faqLeft.q: Does the M264 differ between Mercedes-Benz models?
faqLeft.a: The M264 was only fitted to the C-Class W205 in the UK market. The 1.5L and 2.0L variants share the same base engine code but differ in capacity and output.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes-Benz M264 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,200. Exact price depends on condition and parts required - submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.
Yes. We work on M264 rebuilds across all applications, replacing worn components as standard.

faqLeft.q: Do you work on M264 hybrid applications?
faqLeft.a: Yes. The M264 is a mild-hybrid application with 48V system components that we account for during a rebuild.

faqRight.q: Can you rebuild an M264 from a C-Class?
faqRight.a: Yes. The M264 in the C-Class W205 is one of the applications we work on.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Mercedes-Benz M264 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Mercedes-Benz if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes - nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an M264 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most M264 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.
